taste:
Latin American and Latino comedians, or comedians who tell stories about immigrant and bilingual life.
Spanish-language or Spanglish sets are a plus. Storytelling about family, culture and identity is a plus.
Style can be anything from gentle to edgy, as long as the point of view is Latin.
note: Written by rate.py with the claude backend. The model answered from general knowledge; reasons are not verified. An empty entry means the model did not know the name.
